verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a card-issuing API platform, but the evidence only documents single-item operations: creating one card, or setting the state of one existing card. Related features do not count as bulk operations: retrieving transactions by card, merchant or account holder, merchant-group authorization controls, and card products that govern one or more cards. None of the evidence shows a batch or bulk endpoint, or bulk actions through the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
